'''Makem Liva''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Makem]] in the [[Makem system]],<ref name="GW" /> located in the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Makem Liva had twenty-one [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Makem system]], except [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], were designed for the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'';<ref name="GW" /> however, an excerpt from the sourcebook was published as a promotional preview on the official [[Wizards of the Coast]] website, [[Wizards.com]], a month before the book's release.<ref name="WB">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040205geonosis|text=Makem Te: ''Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds'' Excerpt 2}}</ref> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Makem star system in grid square S-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
